auditor: gpt-5.6-luna (codex exec, effort high, fresh sealed context)

probe_detail.name: Names the concrete failure or limitation it addresses
States why the change is needed
Extent to which a pull-request template is filled in

final.name: Complexity-Discussion Surface Extent
final.audit_justification: Discussion volume is not quality itself, though careful engineering may plausibly produce both extensive discussion and better work.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Simplicity (KISS/YAGNI) and complexity management

final.name: Concurrent-Activity Cue Extent
final.audit_justification: Concurrent-activity cues describe repository context and coordination rather than the contribution’s quality.
final.upstream_parent: Repository busyness around the pull request

final.name: Requirement-Bounded Design Simplicity
final.audit_justification: Requirement-bounded simplicity directly evaluates substantive design judgment and maintainability.

final.name: Semantically Useful Documentation
final.audit_justification: Documentation that accurately communicates behavior and constraints is genuine contribution quality.

final.name: Substantive Behavior-Preserving Refactoring
final.audit_justification: Meaningful behavior-preserving refactoring with controlled risk directly measures engineering quality.

final.name: Evidence of Correct, Complete Contribution
final.audit_justification: Correctness, completeness, validation, and avoidance of technical debt directly assess contribution quality.

final.name: Conventionlessness Cue Extent
final.audit_justification: Conventionlessness cues describe repository idioms and context, not whether the pull request is good.
final.upstream_parent: Early versus late arrival and codebase maturity

final.name: Version-Era Anchor Extent
final.audit_justification: Temporal and version anchors locate the work historically without directly measuring its quality.
final.upstream_parent: Temporal position and project lifecycle stage

final.name: Communication-Scaffolding Extent
final.audit_justification: Communication scaffolding measures visible form and verbosity rather than informational value.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Change/commit/PR communication quality

final.name: Submission-Norm Marker Extent
final.audit_justification: Submission-hygiene markers are template and process artifacts, not evidence of contribution substance.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Contribution readiness and submission norms

final.name: Documentation-Format Marker Extent
final.audit_justification: Formatting conventions measure presentation habits rather than correctness, judgment, or usefulness.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Documentation formatting and style conventions

final.name: Actionable Change Rationale
final.audit_justification: Accurate, proportionate rationale and risk communication are genuine evidence about the contribution.

final.name: Automation-Generated Submission Extent
final.audit_justification: Automation signatures identify production method or boilerplate, not the quality of the resulting contribution.
final.upstream_parent: Repository automation maturity and workflow era

final.name: Shared-History Presupposition Extent
final.audit_justification: Shared-history presuppositions are incidental, but familiarity with the project may plausibly also produce better patches.
final.upstream_parent: Late arrival and accumulated repository history

final.name: Refactor-Presentation Marker Extent
final.audit_justification: Refactor-presentation markers measure packaging and labeling rather than the refactor’s substantive quality.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Refactoring quality and practice
